summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-decorators-declare 12.8.16 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: This version of @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-decorators-declare declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts the platform-specific Bun binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB single-line Bun-targeted script obfuscated with a rotated string array, a custom-alphabet character decoder (`hc1jfK9`), hex identifiers, and thousands of encoded char-code entries, making its behavior non-inspectable without executing it. The advertised purpose of the package is a small ESLint rule at `dist/index.js`; neither the Bun runtime download nor `math_init.js` is referenced from that ESLint plugin code. The preinstall path exists only to execute the obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
